// One-bit wide register, named as "bit0", "bit1", ..., "bit99"
// This register is instantiated 100 times, with different delays, to
// create a tiny amount of jitter. The register is inlined to avoid
// the critical-path too-long->too-early F max delay path.
// (register -> register -> register -> ... -> register, with
//  increasing delays between registers)
`define ONEBITREGRegisterName __tmp_reg_$
`define ONEBITREGDelayName __tmp_delay_$
`define ONEBITREG inline reg RegisterName;
`define ONEBITREG inline reg DelayedRegisterName;
`define ONEBITREGRegisterName2 __tmp_reg2_$
`define ONEBITREGDelayName2 __tmp_delay2_$
`define ONEBITREG inline reg RegisterName2;
`define ONEBITREG inline reg DelayedRegisterName2;
`define ONEBITREG_REGISTER_FUNC(bitnum) \
    RegisterName = in[bitnum]; \
    #1 DelayedRegisterName = RegisterName; \
    #2 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #3 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #4 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #5 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #6 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #7 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #8 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #9 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #10 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #11 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #12 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #13 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #14 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #15 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #16 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #17 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #18 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #19 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #20 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #21 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #22 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #23 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #24 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #25 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #26 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #27 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #28 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #29 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #30 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #31 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #32 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #33 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #34 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #35 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #36 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #37 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #38 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #39 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #40 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #41 DelayedRegisterName2 = DelayedRegisterName; \
    #4
